title: From Low Cost Plant HMW DNA Extraction to MinION Sequencing
author: Julien Serret
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bu3vnyn6
materials: Quantify 1µl of DNA using a Qubit fluorometer.

steps.title: Harvest and grind leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Collect up to 5 g fresh young leaves into a 50 mL clean tube, grind with liquid nitrogen using a mortar and pestle to a fine powder (or use an analytical grinder A15, IKA, Germany for two 10‑second cycles).

steps.title: Lysis with MATAB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 15 mL freshly prepared MATAB lysis buffer (100 mM Tris pH 8, 1.4 M NaCl, 20 mM EDTA pH 8, 1 % PEG 6000, 2 % MATAB, 1 mM DTT) to the ground tissue, homogenize slowly by inversion, incubate at 65 °C for 1 h 30 min with gentle inversion every 15 min. Then add 2.5 µL proteinase K (20 mg mL⁻¹, e.g., Terra PCR Kit) and incubate at 55 °C for 1 h 30 min, inverting gently every 15 min.

steps.title: Chloroform‑Isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add 15 mL Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1, Merck MilliporeSigma, Cat #C0549) and homogenize slowly (manual or horizontal shaker at 5 rpm, room temperature, 12 min). Centrifuge at 4000 rpm, 20 °C for 20 min. Transfer the clear supernatant to a clean 50 mL tube using a 1000 µL pipette tip cut at the tip. If the supernatant is not clear, repeat with an additional 14 mL of the same solvent, shake 12 min, centrifuge as above, and transfer supernatant. Add 16 µL RNase A solution (4 mg mL⁻¹, Promega, Cat #A7973), mix gently and incubate 30 min at room temperature. Add 13 mL Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) again, shake 12 min, centrifuge 4000 rpm, 20 °C, 20 min, and transfer the clear supernatant to a clean tube.

steps.title: DNA precipitation and resuspension
steps.instruction: Add 10 % (v/v) of 3 M sodium acetate pH 5.2 and 70 % (v/v) of 2‑propanol (Merck MilliporeSigma, Cat #190764) to the supernatant, invert very slowly until DNA precipitate appears. Transfer the precipitate with a glass hook into a 2 mL Eppendorf tube containing 1 mL 70 % ethanol, air‑dry for 2 min, then resuspend the pellet in 300 µL ultrapure water in a 1.5 mL tube and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Bead cleanup to avoid shearing
steps.instruction: Before pipetting, cut the extremities of pipette tips with a clean razor blade. Resuspend AMPure XP magnetic beads (room temperature) by vortexing. In a 2 mL tube combine 150 µL beads with 150 µL DNA, flick gently, incubate 10 min at room temperature, place on a magnetic rack, remove supernatant, wash beads twice with 500 µL fresh 70 % ethanol, remove tube from magnet, add 150 µL ultrapure water, incubate at 65 °C until beads fully resuspend (≈2 × 30 s), flick gently.

steps.title: Assess DNA size by PFGE
steps.instruction: Load 20 µL of DNA (1.5–5.5 µg) mixed with 5 µL 6× loading buffer onto a 1 % agarose gel alongside a Lambda Ladder PFGE marker (NEB, Cat #N0340S). Run PFGE with pulse times 5 s to 120 s, total run time 18 h, voltage 5 V cm⁻¹, angle 120°, temperature 14 °C, ending current 255 mA.

steps.title: Short‑read elimination (SRE)
steps.instruction: Follow the Circulomics Short‑Read Eliminator kit (SKUSS‑100‑101‑01) protocol with a 25 kb cut‑off: incubate the DNA overnight at 4 °C in the supplied elution buffer, then proceed to Qubit quantification and library preparation.

steps.title: DNA repair and end‑prep
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL LoBind tube combine 47 µL DNA (9 µg, volume adjusted with 50/50 ultrapure water/TE pH 8), 3.5 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Buffer, 2 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Mix (NEB, Cat #M6630S, 24 rxns), 3.5 µL Ultra II End‑prep Reaction Buffer, and 3 µL Ultra II End‑prep Enzyme Mix. Flick to mix, spin down, then incubate in a thermal cycler 8 min at 20 °C followed by 5 min at 65 °C. Add 50 µL AMPure XP beads, flick, incubate 10 min at room temperature, then place on magnet, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol, remove residual ethanol, elute in 62 µL nuclease‑free water, incubate 2 min at room temperature then 30 s at 65 °C, flick, incubate additional 15 s at 65 °C, keep beads on magnet until eluate is clear, transfer 62 µL eluate to a new LoBind tube, quantify 1 µL with Qubit.

steps.title: Adapter ligation and cleanup
steps.instruction: In a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube mix 61 µL end‑prep eluate, 25 µL Ligation Buffer (LNB), 10 µL NEBNext Quick T4 DNA Ligase, and 5 µL Adapter Mix (AMX). Flick, spin down, incubate 18 min at 20 °C. Add 50 µL AMPure XP beads, flick, incubate 10 min at room temperature, magnet, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 250 µL Long Fragment Buffer (LFB) at room temperature, remove residual LFB, elute beads in 16 µL Elution Buffer (EB), incubate 5 min at room temperature then 5 min at 37 °C, keep on magnet until eluate clear, transfer 16 µL to a clean 0.5 mL LoBind tube, quantify 1 µL with Qubit.

steps.title: Split library and store
steps.instruction: Divide the 16 µL library into two 8 µL aliquots in 0.5 mL LoBind tubes; store one aliquot at 4 °C until needed.

steps.title: First MinION loading (Day 1)
steps.instruction: In the second 8 µL library tube add 4 µL Elution Buffer (EB), 37.5 µL Sequencing Buffer (SQB), and 25.5 µL Loading Beads (LB) (mix immediately before use). Perform a flow‑cell check on a MinION Mk1C with FLO‑MIN106D (R9) flow cell. Prepare priming mix by adding 30 µL Flush Tether (FLT) to a fresh Flush Buffer (FB) tube, vortex. Open the priming port, remove any air bubbles, then load 800 µL priming mix into the priming port (set P1000 to 200 µL, draw 220–230 µL until buffer enters tip). Wait 5 min, remove bubbles again using the same pipette technique. Open the SpotON sample port, load an additional 200 µL priming mix, then gently mix the library by pipetting up/down and slowly add 75 µL of the library into the SpotON port while it remains open. Close ports, close MinION lid, and start a 96‑hour sequencing run.

steps.title: Second MinION loading (Day 3)
steps.instruction: After 48 h, pause the run and wash the flow cell according to ONT protocol EXP‑WSH003. After washing, re‑prime the flow cell as described in the first‑load step. In the stored 8 µL library tube (kept at 4 °C), add 4 µL EB, 37.5 µL SQB, and 25.5 µL LB, mix, and load onto the flow cell following the same SpotON loading procedure. Resume sequencing.

steps.title: Refuel after 72 h if speed drops
steps.instruction: If translocation speed falls below 250 bases s⁻¹ after 72 h, pause the run, open the priming port, remove any bubbles, then load 150 µL Flush Buffer (FB) using a P1000 set to 200 µL (draw 220–230 µL until buffer enters tip). Close the priming port and resume the run.
